descByPlatform.chatgpt: Medium Shot Lifestyle Product Photograph for CLAY & CO NOOK matte-ceramic mug reading-nook editorial. Subject: matte cream Polished Ceramic mug #E9DFD0 with hand-thrown wheel ridges, 'CLAY & CO NOOK' embossed 5pt sans-serif base, steaming black coffee #1A1A1A, on aged oak windowsill #8B7E6E beside an open hardcover book with burgundy linen binding #5A1D20 and cream pages, knitted Merino Wool throw #BFC1BE crumpled foreground, rain-streaked window with diffused grey sky #A8A6A0 and soft bokeh droplets. Composition: Rule of Thirds mug right-third 66% x 52% y, Medium Shot, Eye-Level 0° with 3° downward tilt, subject 44% of frame, Leading Lines along sill. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 80mm LS at f/2.8, 1/200s, ISO 200, tripod. Lighting: Softbox Studio Backlit + Side Lighting — 6×6ft window-scrim camera-right 55° 2.0m overcast (key), 4×4ft white bounce camera-left 1.2m (fill), 1×3ft silver strip rim behind mug 25° (rim on steam), 4×4ft black flag overhead. Material physics: matte-ceramic micro-sheen, wool fibre halo, oak end-grain, condensation on glass. Color grade: Capture One Cool-10 LUT grain 8 +0.1 EV. Palette: cream mug #E9DFD0 30%, oak sill #8B7E6E 24%, burgundy book #5A1D20 16%, wool grey #BFC1BE 18%, sky grey #A8A6A0 12%. References: Kinfolk Magazine, Cereal Magazine, Nordic still-life. Exclude: harsh shadows, plastic sheen, saturated colour, cluttered props, lens flare.
